title: A successful tracy_demo plan.save marks its turn planned instead of throwing a ReferenceError
steps: S1: Run node --test --test-timeout=60000 packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/build-fence-wiring.test.mjs; the test named 'a saved plan marks its own turn planned' drives tracy_demo plan.save with a successful answer, then a tracy_site call.
expect: S1: plan.save answers ok instead of throwing, and the following call sends no guard request to tracy-web.
evidence: Before the fix every plan.save threw ReferenceError: markPlanned is not defined and the session stayed locked behind AGENT_DEMO_PLAN_REQUIRED
fence: The per-turn buildTurns state records the plan from the saved answer
